newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas trades only 3 times as OTC market slows.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas trades only 3 times as OTC market slows.

text.p: The IPE's natural gas futures contract suffered its worst day since its January 31 launch on Friday, with only three trades done totalling 25 lots.
The two-hour morning session saw no trade at all.

A spokeswoman at the IPE was sanguine about the disappointing volume, pointing out that activity was also extremely thin on the physical market on Friday, and that futures brokers were unperturbed by the low volume.

Bids and offers were seen on each of the 12 monthly contracts by the close. In every case except July, the bids and offers straddled the previous night's settlement price, indicating unchanged levels. July, which traded twice, closed 0.175 pence a therm lower.
